label: Week 4
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
headline: Week 4’s loudest room was Cleveland: Browns–Steelers TNF last-second kick chatter led the week after the Panthers comeback set the board. Dallas mixed Brazil fallout (Loop’s Maracanã winner, Steele/Bell/play-call fury) with Joey Porter Jr. trade noise, and Las Vegas rode a 3-0 Saints surge plus Jack Bech’s IR forearm into the Chiefs matchup. Pittsburgh’s Porter rule-out and Ramsey-through-injury talk, Chicago’s Case Keenum Monday rout of Philadelphia, Buffalo’s 3-0 Nickel City grind, Baltimore’s Rio thriller, and Houston’s 0-3 Stroud/OL frustration filled the next tier. All seven nights logged. Quiet clubs stayed quiet. Vibe only.
